title: Filtering enumerated literals by free variables
statement: Fix a natural number $n$, a restriction $\rho_0$ on $n$ variables, and a list $t$ of literals. Enumerate $t$ as the list of pairs $(\ell, i)$, where $\ell$ ranges over the literals of $t$ and $i$ is the position of $\ell$ in $t$, and keep only those pairs whose literal's variable is a free variable of $\rho_0$. Then every pair $(\ell, i)$ surviving this filter is itself one of the enumerated pairs of $t$, and its literal's variable $v$ is free under $\rho_0$, meaning $\rho_0$ leaves $v$ unset.
